args.title: Cold-chain logistics 2026 – combined summary (Ironbark)
args.body:
- Where carriers shared live sensor data, temperature excursions fell 30% (Ironbark blog, 2026).
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilot programs cut claims by about a quarter.

Sources: https://blog.ironbark.example/2026/cold-chain ; https://insights.ironbark.example/cold-chain/companion
